services.desc: Birthday parties don’t have to mean noisy arcades or basic backyard games. At Exitus Escape Rooms in Guelph, Ontario, a birthday becomes an immersive adventure where friends and family become the heroes of the story. Located at 340 Woodlawn Rd. W. in Guelph, Exitus combines themed escape rooms with cutting‑edge virtual reality experiences, offering a party option that feels fresh, modern, and genuinely memorable. Instead of kids scattering in all directions, everyone dives into a shared mission: solve the puzzles, uncover the secrets, and beat the clock together.
